clips.title: The story
paras: Tsunaman sends Horde travelers from Stonetalon Mountains to aid Je'neu Sancrea on Ashenvale's remote coast. The troll scholar waits at Zoram'gar Outpost, where danger gathers along the shore.

Tsunaman hears troubling reports from the north and calls on Horde travelers to reach Je'neu Sancrea. The troll scholar is at Zoram'gar Outpost, on Ashenvale's far western shore, the Zoram Strand. Je'neu faces mounting danger and needs help from beyond the outpost.

The road to Ashenvale's western shore is dangerous for Horde travelers. You can pass through Windshear Crag, disturbed by goblins, or travel north from the Barrens. Either way, you enter forest watched by night elf sentinels. Far beneath Ashenvale's dense canopy, Zoram'gar Outpost holds on along the storm-washed Zoram Strand, facing the shadowed waters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Je'neu Sancrea is in need of aid. He is at the Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale. The Night elf forest is to the north of the Stonetalon mountains. You can reach it by traveling through Windshear Crag or by heading north through Barrens. Zoram Strand is far to the west of the forest. Be careful, friend. There are forces there that will not take to your presence kindly.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Tsunaman sent you? Excellent. Then we have matters to discuss.
